qualifier: NLRP3 and NLRP1 inflammasomes
name: NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasome IL-1/IL-18 maturation and pyroptosis
rationale: Members cover inflammasome assembly (NLRP3, NLRP1, AIM2, P2X7-linked), IL-1/IL-18 processing and signalling and pyroptotic death; unlike C1/C4 it includes pyroptosis and IL-18, and unlike C2/C3 it centres on NLRP3/NLRP1 rather than IPAF/CASP4/5 bacterial sensing.

core: Endothelial VEGFR2 and Tie2 receptor signaling
qualifier: endothelial and lymphatic fate specification
name: VEGFR2/Tie2 signaling in endothelial and lymphatic specification
rationale: Members are VEGF/VEGFR2-neuropilin and Tie2 signalling plus endothelial fate commitment, survival and lymphatic differentiation; confusables lack the lymphatic/fate members and instead cover arterial-venous morphogenesis or positive/negative control of sprouting angiogenesis.

qualifier: CCR7-mediated mature dendritic cell migration and survival
name: CCR7-mediated mature dendritic cell migration and survival
rationale: Members describe CCR7 (CCR1/7) signalling via Cdc42 and PLC/PKC driving mature conventional dendritic cell chemotaxis, homing and survival; confusables cover CXCR4, B/T lymphocyte homing or generic chemokine modules.

core: Vitamin and quinone cofactor metabolism and transport
qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinol
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinol metabolism and transport
rationale: All members concern synthesis, metabolism or membrane transport of thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E or ubiquinol/quinones; confusables instead cover methionine, folate, cobalamin and biotin one-carbon cofactors.

core: Glial cell fate and differentiation control
qualifier: oligodendrocyte, astrocyte and Schwann cell lineages
name: Gliogenic fate control of oligodendrocyte, astrocyte and Schwann cells
rationale: Members regulate glial fate specification and oligodendrocyte, astrocyte and Schwann cell differentiation/myelination, including suppression of neuronal differentiation; confusables cover CNS myelin maintenance/gliosis or neuroblast and neuronal differentiation.

qualifier: Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation and host restriction
name: HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation and host antiviral restriction
rationale: Members are HIV Nef/Vpu-mediated downregulation or proteasomal degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I plus HIV entry and host suppression of viral entry/release; confusables cover proteasome and MHC-I presentation, HIV reverse transcription or PD-L1 regulation.

qualifier: HuR/AUF1 stability and L13a translational silencing
name: HuR/AUF1 3'-UTR mRNA stability and translational silencing
rationale: Members concern 3'-UTR-dependent mRNA stabilisation/destabilisation by HuR and AUF1, translational silencing and mRNA localisation; confusables emphasise TTP/BRF1/KSRP decay, stress granules or RNA editing.

core: Blood coagulation and fibrin clot turnover
qualifier: fibrinolysis and VWF-dependent platelet adhesion
name: Coagulation, fibrinolysis and VWF-dependent platelet adhesion
rationale: Members span the coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and dissolution, plasminogen activation and VWF-GPIb/collagen platelet adhesion variants; confusables focus on F8/F9 defects, contact-pathway FXII/kallikrein or FV variants.

qualifier: lymphoid organ homing and development
name: Chemokine-guided leukocyte chemotaxis and lymphoid organ homing
rationale: Members cover chemokine/S1P receptor signalling (CCR7, CXCR4) with Rac/Cdc42 motility driving T, B, DC, NK and mast cell chemotaxis plus lymph node and mucosal lymphoid tissue development; confusables are integrin-mediated adhesion or monocyte differentiation modules.

qualifier: beta-catenin destruction complex, Wnt/Ca2+ and Hippo-YAP
name: Wnt/beta-catenin, Wnt/Ca2+ and Hippo-YAP signaling
rationale: Members cover canonical Wnt/beta-catenin (destruction complex and its cancer mutants, Wnt secretion), Wnt/Ca2+ signalling and Hippo-YAP/TAZ density signalling; confusables are planar cell polarity, Notch/Hedgehog or RUNX3/TGF-beta mutant sets.

core: IL-6-family cytokine receptor signaling via STAT
qualifier: LIF, CNTF and IL-11 gp130 cytokines
name: gp130 cytokine signaling via LIF, CNTF and IL-11
rationale: Members are IL-6-type cytokine signalling through LIF, CNTF, IL-11 and oncostatin M with STAT activation; C1 is IL-6 itself and C3/C4 are IL-2/IL-7/STAT5 common-gamma and hematopoietic cytokines.

qualifier: laminin-dystroglycan linkage and collagen anchoring fibrils
name: Basement membrane laminin-dystroglycan and collagen anchoring fibrils
rationale: Members cover basement membrane laminin, proteoglycans, integrins, collagen trimerization/anchoring fibrils and the dystroglycan complex with AChR clustering; confusables cover collagen crosslinking/elastic fibres, hemidesmosomes or myogenesis without anchoring fibrils.

core: Regulation of stress-activated JNK and p38 MAPK cascades
qualifier: TAK1 and ALPK1 activation
name: Regulation of TAK1-dependent JNK and p38 MAPK cascades
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate JNK and p38 stress kinase cascades, including TAK1-mediated activation, ALPK1 and TNF signalling; confusables cover ERK/AP-1 feedback, TLR-driven TAK1 complex assembly or NOD signalling.

qualifier: NUDT pool sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: Purine (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism, NUDT sanitization and thiopurines
rationale: Members cover breakdown of purine nucleotides/nucleosides (AMP, IMP, adenosine, inosine, allantoin, ADA/PNP), NUDT hydrolysis of (d)NTPs and azathioprine/TPMT; confusables are de novo purine synthesis/salvage or pyrimidine catabolism.

qualifier: desmosomes and hemidesmosomes in epithelium and heart
name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome adhesion in epithelium and heart
rationale: Members cover desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate filament bundling, epithelial and cardiomyocyte adhesion with laminin/anchoring collagen; confusables are integrin/basement membrane, cornification or adherens junction and apical polarity sets.

qualifier: Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4 signal release
name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis of Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4
rationale: Members are receptor cleavage and intracellular-domain release for Notch1-4, p75NTR (with NRIF/NF-kB outputs) and ERBB4; confusables cover Notch intracellular-domain transcriptional output rather than processing.

qualifier: Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy types
name: Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy glycosaminoglycan degradation
rationale: Members cover heparan, chondroitin/dermatan and keratan sulfate degradation and the MPS III, IV and VI diseases; confusables hold the Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Natowicz types.

qualifier: CDH1, CDH11 and TGFBR3
name: Transcriptional control of cadherin and TGFBR3 genes
rationale: Members are positive and negative transcriptional regulation of CDH1, CDH11 and TGFBR3 plus generic transcriptional repression; confusables cover TGF-beta EMT signalling, RUNX3 targets, DNA-binding regulation or BMP mesenchymal programmes.

qualifier: ribosome-associated mRNA and nascent-chain quality control
name: Cytoplasmic translation and ribosome-associated mRNA quality control
rationale: Members span translation initiation, elongation and termination with NMD, no-go/non-stop decay and ribosome quality control; confusables are protein hydroxylation/hypusination or nuclear RNA transcription, splicing and processing.

qualifier: MSH2, MSH3, MSH6 and MLH1 deficiency
name: DNA mismatch repair and MSH/MLH1 deficiency
rationale: All members concern mismatch repair, defective via MSH2, MSH3, MSH6 or MLH1 or in meiosis; confusables are double-strand break and recombination repair.

qualifier: germinal center, isotype switching and plasma cells
name: Germinal center isotype switching and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover Tfh and germinal center B cell differentiation, IgG/IgA class switching, plasma cell differentiation and B/plasma cell immunoglobulin modules; confusables cover BCR signalling, B cell development and T cell activation.

qualifier: second heart field, outflow tract and pharyngeal arteries
name: Second heart field, outflow tract and pharyngeal artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe heart tube formation, second heart field specification, neural crest-driven outflow tract septation and pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary artery morphogenesis; confusables centre on atria, valves, trabeculae and conduction system.

qualifier: G-CSF/GM-CSF-driven neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell
name: G-CSF/GM-CSF-driven granulocyte, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover G-CSF/GM-CSF signalling, transcriptional and retinoid control of granulopoiesis and neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation; confusables cover M-CSF/macrophage-monocyte fate, RUNX targets or negative regulation of granulopoiesis.

qualifier: primitive and definitive erythropoiesis
name: Primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation and hemopoiesis
rationale: Most members concern primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation, late erythroid programmes and restraint of HSC differentiation (one TAK1/ATF module is an outlier); confusables cover HSC homeostasis, myeloid progenitors or erythroid-megakaryocytic commitment.

qualifier: ovulation, corpus luteum and progesterone
name: Ovulation, corpus luteum function and progesterone signaling
rationale: Members cover ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, progesterone synthesis and response and the estrous cycle; confusables cover male gonad development, follicle growth/oocyte maturation and gonadotropin control.
